Power Station | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, to be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
Its function is lifting and lowering the rotor of main generator, movabale parts and auxiliaries.
The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed El-Lethy Ahmed, tested by eng. Abdel-Gawad Yousef, accepted by eng. Atty Sefain Rezq allah: general manager, approved by eng. approved by eng. Mohamed Abd El Baset: Head Sector of Aswan Dam 1&2 PS and certified by by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem: HPGC inspection and quality control general director & MPIS Coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, and the qualified maintenance staff must carry the suitable safety category.
Maintenance staff should will trained & qualified or directly supervised by some one.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area are required.
Safety and healthy equipment must be used.
